paragraphs: Rabbi Ba bar Yonah, in Rav’s name. Know that he is Rabbi Abba, since the Jerusalem Talmud habitually omits the alef. So Yuchasin writes under bet; I did not find mention of this name. Perhaps he is bar Mina, mentioned above.
